title: Guilds of Ravnica: card flavor text

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Boros angel and guildmaster who speaks of fighting for Sunhome.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: Boros leader who distrusts the other guilds and confronts Aurelia.

entities.name: Libuse
entities.description: A Boros sergeant.

entities.name: Emmara
entities.description: A Selesnya leader who speaks of trust, peace and unity.

entities.name: Heruj
entities.description: A Selesnya hierophant.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: A Selesnya leader who speaks of the guildgate and friends and enemies.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Dimir spymaster who says he has been a member of all the guilds and speaks of spreading rumors.

entities.name: Nefara
entities.description: A Dimir agent.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A Dimir figure who speaks of those summoned to the guild.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Azorius sphinx who gathered the guilds to propose cooperation.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker and queen of the Golgari Swarm, commanding the Erstwhile.

entities.name: Izoni
entities.description: A Golgari Devkarin who speaks of pets, rats and the loss of Jarad.

entities.name: Jarad Vod Savo
entities.description: A former Golgari leader remembered as a friend to the Devkarin.

entities.name: Cevraya
entities.description: A Golgari shaman.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker who found himself leading the Izzet League after Niv-Mizzet disappeared.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet guildmaster dragon who no longer recognizes his guild.

entities.name: Mizzix of the Izmagnus
entities.description: An Izzet figure who jokes about the Izzet being blamed for disasters.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Gruul-aligned planeswalker who speaks against obeying the guilds.

entities.name: Commander Yaszen
entities.description: A Boros commander who trains soldiers at Sacred Foundry.

entities.name: Milana
entities.description: An Orzhov prelate.

entities.name: Karlov of the Ghost Council
entities.description: A member of the Orzhov Ghost Council.

entities.name: Ghut Rak
entities.description: A Gruul guildmage.

entities.name: Zalin the Gutter Bard
entities.description: A bard who gives warnings in song and speech.

entities.name: Firemane Kavrova
entities.description: A Boros figure who speaks of mercy and the strong.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of soldiers, whose Sunhome is the home of the Legion.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of nature and unity centered on Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of spies and secrets, which rarely makes statements.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of the undercity, now under Vraska.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of inventors and mages led by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of priests and moneylenders.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of law and order.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of the Rubblebelt wilds.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of performers and revelers.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of bioengineers.

entities.name: Erstwhile
entities.description: A zombie army unearthed from tombs and put at Vraska's command.

entities.name: Kraul
entities.description: Insectoid people who became valued forces of the Swarm.

entities.name: Ghost Council
entities.description: The council of ghosts that leads the Orzhov.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the guilds struggle for power.

entities.name: Ilharg
entities.description: The mighty Raze-Boar that some Gruul believe will rise and level the city.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: The Boros guild home.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The great tree of the Selesnya Conclave.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: A reminder that bitter struggles can end in cooperation.

entities.name: Duskmantle
entities.description: A rarely believed-in Dimir stronghold.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: The network of tunnels beneath Ravnica where the Golgari live.

events.summary: Isperia gathers the guilds in a climate of suspicion to propose cooperation.
events.quote: Isperia gathered the guilds to propose a radical idea: cooperation.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet disappears and Ral finds himself leading the Izzet.
events.quote: Ral found himself leading the guild.

events.summary: Ral's storm detects planeswalkers infiltrating Ravnica.
The Erstwhile are unearthed and become an army for Vraska.
events.quote: When the Erstwhile were unearthed from their tombs, they became a ready-made army for Vraska.

events.summary: Vraska rises and the kraul become valued forces of the Swarm.
events.quote: with Vraska's rise, they became valued forces of the Swarm.

events.summary: Tajic angrily lists attacks on Boros to Aurelia and doubts her talk of peace.
events.quote: Three daggers left in an angel's back

events.summary: Lazav tells that some guilds may have fallen under an invader's influence.
events.quote: We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence.

events.summary: Vraska orders the Golgari gates shut so the Underrealm can outlast the coming doom.
events.quote: Shut the gates. In the Underrealm we will outlast the coming doom.

events.summary: Ral first harnesses the power of an entire guild.
events.quote: had never harnessed the power of an entire guild

events.summary: Domri calls on people to defy the guilds' promises of obedience and safety.
Aurelia urges troops to fight for Sunhome with the truth in their hearts.
events.quote: You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet admits he did not recognize his own guild yesterday.
events.quote: Yesterday I didn't recognize my own guild.

relations.note: Ral leads the Izzet after Niv-Mizzet's disappearance.
relations.quote: Ral found himself leading the guild.

relations.note: Niv-Mizzet speaks of his own guild.
relations.quote: Yesterday I didn't recognize my own guild.
they became a ready-made army for Vraska

relations.note: Kraul became valued forces of the Swarm.
relations.quote: they became valued forces of the Swarm

relations.note: Karlov sits on the Ghost Council.
Ghut Rak is a Gruul guildmage.
Izoni says Jarad was a friend to the Devkarin.
relations.quote: Jarad was a friend to the Devkarin.
